links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs versus neurologists on same real-world cases
links.effect: Neurologists achieved 75% diagnostic accuracy, outperforming ChatGPT-3.5 (54%) and Gemini (46%).
links.quote: Neurologists achieved a diagnostic accuracy of 75%, outperforming ChatGPT-3.5 (54%) and Gemini (46%).

links.outcome: LLM performance on real-world clinical workflow cases versus structured benchmark-style prompts
links.effect: On real-world neurology cases, LLMs struggled with complex or ambiguous presentations, sometimes needing extra prompts; accuracy 54% and 46% versus neurologists 75%.
links.quote: Despite their ability to generate structured recommendations, they struggled with complex or ambiguous presentations, requiring additional prompts in some cases.

unlisted_practices: Systematic review of LLM evaluation methodologies in neurology

screen.reason: The study evaluated ChatGPT-3.5 and Gemini against neurologists on 28 retrospective real-world clinical records to test diagnostic accuracy and test recommendation appropriateness, but did not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
